body.statement: If \(G_n\) is edgeless, then \(D_n=\lambda_n=1\), every \(B_{n,i}=\varnothing\), and \(q_{n,i}=1/4\). The fixed \(r=2\) CGD estimator is therefore a sum of independent modified Horvitz--Thompson endpoint contrasts, and \(K_n(1;B,c)\to0\), recovering the classical independent triangular-array central limit theorem under the stated fourth moments and variance floor.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check at the no-interference boundary.
body.gap: This is a consistency check against classical Berry--Esseen theory rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It verifies that the frontier does not distort ordinary independent randomization inference.
